kkhīni.g: Kāmañcāyaṁ therī suṭṭhu saṁyatatāya santindriyā, tāya thiravippasannasommasantanayananipātesu kammānubhāvanipphannesu pasannapañcappasādapaṭimaṇḍitesu nayanesu labbhamāne pabhāvisiṭṭha2 cāturiye diṭṭhipāte yasmā sayaṁ caritahāvabhāvavilāsādiparikappavañcito so dhutto jāto, tasmāssa3 diṭṭhirāgo savisesaṁ vepullaṁ agamāsi.
